Hi Marissa,

Great to meet you briefly at the hallway track yesterday. We'd love to book a 30-min demo of Redwood during KubeCon while I'm on site. I'm traveling from London and want to avoid the usual timezone screw-up: are you available Nov 7 at 10:00 AM PT (San Diego local time)? That should be 6:00 PM for me (CET) but I'm moving between hotel and venue so wanted to double-check.

If 10am PT works, please send an invite (I tend to trust calendar invites with explicit timezone). If not, I can do earlier (8am PT) as well.

Also, if you need to loop in anyone on your side for an onsite setup or demo laptop, please cc them.

Thanks,
Alex

I'm currently still on London time and will be jet-lagged; would it be possible to move it to 8:00 AM PT instead (that would be 4:00 PM CET for me)? 8am PT is early for your team but keeps me from staying up too late.
